note: One entry per mutation-task bank source (generate.py --repo NAME). commit is the healthy state that is mutated (base_commit = fix_commit of every task); source_task is the P6 task (experiments/p6_pilot/tasks.json) whose fix commit it is, and generate.py checks that its repo, repo_url and fix_commit agree. The test command is fixed by the evaluator (experiments/p6_pilot/evaluate_task.py): `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --junitxml=... <test files: test_root/test_glob>` with PYTHONPATH = <workspace>/src for a src layout, else the workspace; pythonpath must say which. excluded_tests are baseline tests left out of every task's fail_to_pass and pass_to_pass (and allowed to fail in the generator's baseline), each with its reason. test_requirements are the test dependencies beyond pytest; each must be pinned in experiments/cloud/bugs-venv.requirements.txt and experiments/p6_pilot/oci/requirements.lock (tests/test_mutation_repos.py checks this and the clone pins in experiments/cloud/setup_cloud.sh). prefilter_unexecuted drops, before scheduling, candidates whose smallest enclosing statement never executed in a probed healthy run (see generate.py); it is off for sqlparse, whose bank predates it.

excluded_tests.tests.test_jsonutils::test_reverse_iter_: platform-dependent: reads an LF data file in text mode and compares with a binary read, so it fails on Windows (text mode translates newlines) and passes on Linux; measured 2026-09-28 on the host bugs-venv and in localhost/reticle-p6-task:py313-v1
